title: Anthropic removes fast mode for Claude Opus 4.8 on November 30, 2026
detail: Anthropic deprecated fast mode for Claude Opus 4.8 on October 30, 2026, with removal on November 30, 2026. After removal, requests to claude-opus-4-8 with speed: "fast" return an error. The Claude Code changelog adds that these requests do not fall back to standard Opus 4.8. Anthropic's stated migration path is Claude Opus 5.5.
impact: Any integration sending fast mode requests to Opus 4.8 will start failing on November 30 rather than degrading. To keep the speedup, switch those calls to Opus 5.5 before then; to stay on Opus 4.8, drop the fast setting.
